taste.name: Contrast Is a Reward, Not a Backdrop
taste.trigger: Deciding how much of the palette's contrast to spend on the resting page versus the interaction
taste.decision: Chose flat, low-contrast green-on-cream everywhere over spending contrast anywhere before the flip
taste.reason: A visitor scanning three audience options shouldn't feel pulled toward one before reading it; the contrast payoff should arrive after commitment, as confirmation
evidence: flipped state is the only cream-on-green frame captured

taste.name: Two Colors, No Escape Hatch
taste.decision: Chose the same 2 hex values for every card and state over a per-audience accent color
taste.reason: Three audiences inviting three brand colors is a common trap that turns a selector into a hierarchy by hue; staying inside 2 colors keeps all three paths reading as equally legitimate
evidence: accentCandidates = same 2 values across all cards

taste.name: The Hero Argues Before It Shows
taste.trigger: Opening a page about physical, photogenic things — cattle, pasture, land
taste.decision: Chose ~900px of pure typography on flat cream over an image-led, photo-background hero
taste.reason: A hero photo front-loads whose land/cattle you're looking at before the visitor has chosen an audience; withholding imagery until the card section means the first photo shown is already relevant to the path they're leaning toward
evidence: hero is min-h-screen of type only
images.length === 3, all role: feature, all inside cards

taste.name: Containers Own Spacing, Elements Don't
taste.trigger: Laying out 3 internally-complex cards (image, eyebrow, title, teaser, plus back-face description and two buttons)
taste.decision: Chose margin: 0 on every element plus gap on containers over per-element margin tuning
taste.reason: A page whose entire content is '3 identical cards, twice' needs the 3 cards to be provably identical — gap-only spacing makes drift between them structurally impossible rather than a matter of discipline
evidence: margin: 0px on 7/7 sampled tags (section, h1, h2, h3, p, ul, button)
gap present on ul and section instead
